title: Sensitivity Growth Under Boolean Conjunctions
statement: If Boolean functions $f_1,\ldots,f_n$ have average maximal sensitivity $O((\log n)^d)$, and each $g_i$ is the conjunction of a subset of the $f_j$, must the average maximal sensitivity of the $g_i$ be $O((\log n)^{d+1})$?
